title: Exponential Family Synthetic Controls
abstract: arXiv:2609.23970v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We develop exponential family synthetic controls (EFSC), a distributional version of synthetic controls for a panel of datasets. Each cell of the panel corresponds to a dataset drawn from an exponential family whose natural parameters factorize probabilistically across units and times. We estimate the latent factors using black-box variational inference. This replaces the usual weighted-average view of synthetic controls with a flexible probabilistic model that operates on full distributions. We propose causal estimands based on divergences between pre- and post-intervention distributions induced by the posterior of the natural parameters, together with distributional placebo tests to support causal inference and assess the significance of the estimated effects. We validate the proposed framework on synthetic and real data. Across a variety of exponential-family distributions, EFSC accurately recovers causal effects induced by exponent

translated_abstract: 我们开发了指数族合成控制（EFSC），这是一种面向面板数据集的分布化版本的合成控制方法。面板的每个单元格对应一个从指数族中抽取的数据集，其自然参数在个体和时间维度上进行概率化分解。我们使用黑盒变分推断来估计潜在因子。该方法用一种作用于完整分布的灵活概率模型，取代了传统合成控制中常用的加权平均视角。我们提出了基于自然参数后验所诱导的干预前与干预后分布之间散度的因果估计量，并结合分布安慰剂检验来支持因果推断以及评估所估计效应的显著性。我们在合成数据和真实数据上验证了所提出的框架。在多种指数族分布上，EFSC 能够准确恢复由指数……
tldr: 提出了指数族合成控制（EFSC），一种用黑盒变分推断建模完整分布、并通过分布间散度定义因果估计量与分布安慰剂检验来实现因果推断的分布化合成控制方法。
en_tdlr: We propose Exponential Family Synthetic Controls (EFSC), a distributional extension of synthetic controls that uses black-box variational inference to model full distributions, with divergence-based causal estimands and distributional placebo tests for causal inference.
